limitation: The report describes one disputed incident and does not establish a system-wide Patriot failure rate; attribution and mechanism remain contested.
observation: Al Jazeera Arabic reported a Reuters-reviewed academic and forensic analysis that a U.S.-operated Patriot battery was likely responsible for an interceptor explosion in Bahrain; analysts said the trajectory could indicate an unsuccessful interception or technical malfunction, while Iran claimed the U.S. weapon caused the civilian damage.
